title: Planning invariant test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized cross-aggregate invariant test by deterministic fixture and driver responsibility while preserving the full property corpus. Deliverable: planning-invariant-fixtures.ts owns hashes, witnesses, seeded generators, perturbation, commands, and traces; planning-invariant-drivers.ts owns valid-state drivers/seed pools; planning-invariants.test.ts retains the invariant assertions. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6. NOT in scope: production changes, seed/count reduction, weaker equality/freezing assertions, or new lifecycle policy. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariants.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariant-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-invariant-drivers.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: The same deterministic seed set, command traces, digest perturbations, multi-node cases, lifecycle ranks, and terminal-state corpus are exercised.
Every existing invariant assertion remains and still proves determinism, monotonic lifecycle, exact-hash refusal, zero state change, deep freezing, successor isolation, and terminal graph authority.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and support modules contain no Vitest registration or production exports.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

Per-symbol regex extraction of xorshift32, perturb, summaries, finalizeWitness, expectDeepFrozen, runCommand, pickRunKind, runTrace, revisionCommand, revisionTrace, driveRun and runSeedPool, each `export `-stripped, all 12 confirmed byte-contained in `git show HEAD:...planning-invariants.test.ts`; on top of that the three whole bodies are contiguous substrings of that blob. (b) SUPPORT-MODULE RAILS. describe(/it(/test( = 0 in both modules. Zero overlap with packages/core/src/index.ts (0 references to either module; none of the 26 exported names appear there). Zero module-level `let` in either module — every `let` is function-local (xorshift32's closure, and the loop cursors that came over verbatim), so no cross-test mutable state was introduced by the split. (c) HYGIENE. All three files LF-only (0 CR), final newline present, no tabs, no trailing whitespace. Scratchpad baseline and the commit message live in %TEMP%, outside the repo; no debug/probe/scratch file anywhere in the tree.

(d) COVERAGE ARITHMETIC. fixtures = old 25-101, drivers = old 102-314, test = old 316-432; old 1-23 was the import block, rewritten. Boundaries are blank lines, no overlap (101<102, 314<316), no orphaned line.

(e) MUTATION TESTING — the check that a green refactor cannot give you. Green alone proves nothing here, so I broke the moved code on purpose to confirm the corpus still bites through the new module boundary: making perturb an identity (fixtures) turned "rejects every perturbed approval and activation digest with zero state change" red, 1 failed / 6 passed; flipping SEALED_STEPS from roll 3 to roll 1 (drivers) turned "never moves either aggregate backward", "keeps every multi-node graph out of plan review..." and "refuses a multi-node admission..." red, 3 failed / 4 passed. Both reverted, and byte containment against HEAD re-confirmed after the revert so no mutation residue shipped.

ADVERSARIAL ANGLES CONSIDERED, no risk found: the `as const` witness objects are shared module singletons exactly as they were pre-split (constructed once, spread-copied not mutated at every use site, so exporting them adds no aliasing hazard); module evaluation order is unchanged because nothing at module scope calls a driver — the *_STEPS pools are pure array literals and driveRun only runs inside a test; runTrace calling runSeedPool defined later still works via function-declaration hoisting, same as before; importing `expect` into a non-.test module would throw outside a vitest run, which is why the modules are only reachable from the test file, matching the two sibling fixture modules already in this directory.
